title: Three Weeks and One Short Bandage
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：pain　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pain 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the doctor ① bore the pain that no patient in the clinic would have noted, and he said the bearing was the whole of the week. The ② pain, meaning the ache itself and not the bandage, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; pain, he said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ touch of pain in that clinic had the same short bandage beside it, and the ④ pain at the far bed, meaning the scar they kept for the children to cover and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Pain, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the doctor said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pain was the whole of the matter, meaning the sorrow and not the ache. The ⑥ pain, meaning the sorrow and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; pain, he said, is either something you bear or the only word that means both ache and a sorrow. He said the sorrow is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ pain had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short bandage. The ⑧ pain of the whole thing, the doctor wrote in January, was one clinic and three weeks of noting; pain, he said, is either the scar at the far bed or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pain I remember is the pain noted in the chart, which closed in 1989 and is still noted as the quietest in the clinic. ⑩ Pain, my mother said in 1991, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all pain, she said, is a sorrow that has agreed to look like ache. She said the sorrow was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 疼痛；痛苦（指卫生所里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 疼痛；痛苦（指那处疼痛本身，与窄窄的绷带相对）
C. 固定搭配：bear the pain 忍这一处疼痛
D. n. 疼痛；痛苦（指留给孩子们遮着的那一道）
E. n. 疼痛之事（抽象总称，指一处卫生所的疼痛之事）
F. n. 疼痛；痛苦（指病历里写到、被记下的那一处）
G. n. 疼痛、苦楚（指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 苦楚（抽象总称，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bore the pain that no patient in the clinic would have noted
The pain, meaning the ache itself and not the bandage
Every touch of pain in that clinic
the pain at the far bed
the pain was the whole of the matter
the pain had become a line in a chart
The pain of the whole thing

answers.why: bear the pain 意为“忍这一处疼痛”，1982 年那位大夫把卫生所里没有一位病人肯记下的一处疼痛做了一遍。
pain 意为“疼痛；痛苦”，指那处疼痛本身而不是窄窄的绷带，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
pain 意为“疼痛；痛苦”，指卫生所里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一卷窄窄的绷带。
pain 意为“疼痛；痛苦”，指最远那张床边的留给孩子们遮着的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pain 意为“疼痛、苦楚”，指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这处苦楚就是那件事的全部。
pain 意为“苦楚”，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处疼痛，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pain 意为“疼痛；痛苦”，指病历里写到、被记下的那一处，到 1987 年这一处成了病历里的一行。
pain 意为“疼痛之事”，大夫一月写道，整件事的疼痛之事是一处卫生所和三个星期的记下。
pain 意为“疼痛；痛苦”，我记得的是病历里记下过的那一处，1989 年养好了，至今仍被说成卫生所里最安静的一处。
pain 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，疼痛是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的疼痛。
